description: Flat record-level metadata schema for bioactive compounds isolated from traditional medicinal plants and assessed by chromatography, spectroscopy, and cellular bioactivity assays for nutraceutical development.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual compound record or analytical entry.

plant_scientific_name.descr: Accepted scientific name of the source medicinal plant (Genus species; include author if available).

plant_family.descr: Taxonomic family of the source plant.

plant_common_name.descr: Common or local name of the plant used in traditional medicine.

plant_part_used.descr: Plant material used for extraction (e.g., leaf, root, bark, flower, seed).

traditional_use_context.descr: Traditional medicinal use or ethnobotanical indication associated with the plant material.

geographic_origin.descr: Country, region, or locality where the plant sample was collected or sourced.

collection_date.descr: Date the plant material was collected or obtained, formatted as date.

voucher_specimen_id.descr: Herbarium or voucher specimen identifier for botanical traceability.

cultivation_status.descr: Whether the plant was wild-harvested, cultivated, greenhouse-grown, or commercially sourced.

sample_preparation_method.descr: Preparation steps before extraction (e.g., fresh, air-dried, lyophilized, pulverized).

extraction_method.descr: Extraction technique used (e.g., maceration, Soxhlet, ultrasound-assisted, supercritical CO2).

extraction_solvent.descr: Primary solvent or solvent system used for extraction (e.g., methanol, ethanol-water 70:30).

extraction_temperature_c.descr: Extraction temperature in degrees Celsius, if applicable.

extraction_time_h.descr: Extraction duration in hours, if applicable.

compound_isolation_method.descr: Method used to isolate the compound from the crude extract (e.g., preparative HPLC, flash chromatography).

chromatography_technique.descr: Chromatographic method used for separation or purity assessment (e.g., HPLC, GC-MS, TLC, UHPLC).

chromatography_column.descr: Column type and stationary phase used for chromatographic analysis (e.g., C18, silica, chiral column).

chromatography_mobile_phase.descr: Mobile phase composition used in chromatography, including gradients where relevant.

retention_time_min.descr: Observed retention time of the compound in minutes, if chromatographic data are available.

detector_type.descr: Detector used in chromatography (e.g., UV, PDA, MS, DAD, ELSD).

purity_percent.descr: Estimated purity of the isolated compound in percent, if determined.

compound_name.descr: Assigned compound name or common identifier.

compound_class.descr: Chemical class of the compound (e.g., flavonoid, alkaloid, terpenoid, phenolic acid).

molecular_formula.descr: Molecular formula of the compound, if established.

molecular_weight_da.descr: Molecular weight or exact mass in Daltons.

spectroscopy_techniques.descr: Spectroscopic methods used for structural elucidation (e.g., NMR, MS, IR, UV-Vis).

nmr_spectrometer_field_mhz.descr: NMR instrument field strength in MHz, if applicable.

ms_ionization_mode.descr: Mass spectrometry ionization mode used (e.g., ESI+, ESI-, EI).

fragmentation_pattern.descr: Key MS/MS fragment ions or diagnostic fragmentation features supporting identification.

structural_confirmation_level.descr: Confidence level for structural assignment (e.g., tentative, putative, confirmed by standards).

reference_standard_used.descr: Whether an authentic reference standard was used for compound confirmation.

antioxidant_assay_name.descr: Name of the antioxidant assay used in cells or cell-based systems (e.g., DCFH-DA, ROS inhibition, lipid peroxidation assay).

anti_inflammatory_assay_name.descr: Name of the anti-inflammatory assay used (e.g., NO inhibition, TNF-alpha suppression, COX-2 expression assay).

cell_line_name.descr: Cell line or primary cell type used in the bioactivity assay (e.g., RAW 264.7, THP-1, HaCaT).

cell_species.descr: Species origin of the cell line or cells used.

assay_concentration_value.descr: Test concentration of the compound for the reported endpoint, in the stated concentration units.

assay_concentration_unit.descr: Concentration unit used for assay testing (e.g., uM, mg/mL, ug/mL).

assay_time_h.descr: Exposure or incubation time in hours for the cellular assay.

antioxidant_activity_value.descr: Quantitative antioxidant activity result corresponding to the assay endpoint (e.g., % inhibition, IC50, fold change).

antioxidant_activity_unit.descr: Unit for the antioxidant activity value (e.g., %, uM, fold change).

anti_inflammatory_activity_value.descr: Quantitative anti-inflammatory activity result corresponding to the assay endpoint (e.g., % inhibition, IC50, cytokine reduction).

anti_inflammatory_activity_unit.descr: Unit for the anti-inflammatory activity value (e.g., %, uM, pg/mL).

positive_control_used.descr: Name of the reference or positive control compound used in the assay.

negative_control_used.descr: Name of the negative control or vehicle control used in the assay.

replicate_number.descr: Number of experimental replicates reported for the measurement.

mean_value.descr: Mean observed value for the reported bioactivity or analytical measurement.

standard_deviation.descr: Standard deviation associated with the mean value.

p_value.descr: Statistical significance value associated with the result, if available.

statistics_method.descr: Statistical test or analysis method used (e.g., t-test, ANOVA, nonlinear regression).

toxicity_observed.descr: Whether cytotoxicity or adverse cellular effects were observed under the tested conditions.

selectivity_index.descr: Selectivity index or related specificity metric, if calculated.

mechanism_of_action_notes.descr: Brief mechanistic interpretation linking the compound to antioxidant or anti-inflammatory effects.

standardization_marker.descr: Whether the compound is proposed as a marker for standardization of nutraceutical products.

nutraceutical_relevance_notes.descr: Notes on how the compound supports health-benefit claims or product development relevance.

quality_control_notes.descr: Any quality control, validation, or analytical caveats relevant to the record.

analysis_date.descr: Date of chromatographic/spectroscopic/bioactivity analysis for this record, formatted as date.

analyst_id.descr: Identifier of the researcher, laboratory, or instrument operator responsible for the analysis.

instrument_platform.descr: Major instrument platform(s) used across chromatography, spectroscopy, or bioassay measurement.

data_file_reference.descr: Pointer to raw data file, chromatogram, spectrum, or assay output associated with the record.
